title: Four Cakes by Half Past Two  (两点半前烤好四只蛋糕)

segments.t: 十秒钟后，在暖融融的咖啡角厨房里，泰莎和欧文正从容地剥着杏仁，汉娜突然推开弹簧门冲进来，竖起了三根手指。先一起来听听看。
Emergency bulletin from the station desk: our mapmaker arrives at three sharp today!
Three in the afternoon?! Owen, turn both ovens up to baking heat this second!
Both switches on! How fast can four berry almond cakes bake AND cool, Tessa?
Forty minutes in the oven, thirty minutes to cool, ten minutes for warm honey glaze!
That brings us to twenty-five past two — with thirty-five minutes to spare!
I will grease all four round tins with butter while you whisk the eggs, Tessa!
Hannah, rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries and pat them dry with linen!
Rinsing fast and gentle! Thank goodness we tested all three glazes on Sunday!
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish or Batch Two roof tiles at three today!
Less joking and faster whisking, Owen — fold the ground almonds in smoothly!
Wait — hear Graham calling my name from the lobby? Something happened with the room keys!
Go save the front desk, Hannah; Owen and I own this kitchen until half past two!
汉娜一口气冲进厨房报信，泰莎和欧文二话不说立刻开启了极速烘焙模式。这一段里满是精准的时间推算和厨房实用动词，我们逐句来听。
Emergency bulletin from the station desk: our mapmaker arrives at three sharp today!
'车站问询台发来紧急快讯：咱们的制图老先生今天下午三点整准时到！' 汉娜一推门就用播报突发新闻的口吻喊出急报，bulletin 指“简报、紧急通告”：
Emergency bulletin from the station desk
紧接着用“整点时间 + sharp”点出分秒不差的到站时刻：
arrives at three sharp today
Three in the afternoon?! Owen, turn both ovens up to baking heat this second!
'下午三点？！欧文，马上把两台烤箱都调到烘焙温度！' 泰莎反应极快，立刻指挥欧文把烤箱温度拧上去。turn up 表示“调高音量、火力或温度”：
turn both ovens up to baking heat
结尾的 this second 把“现在”夸张成了“就在这一秒”，比 right now 更有火烧眉毛的紧迫感：
this second
Both switches on! How fast can four berry almond cakes bake AND cool, Tessa?
'两个开关都打开了！四只浆果杏仁蛋糕最快多久能烤好又晾凉呀，泰莎？' 欧文啪啪按下开关，马上问起最现实的工期问题。用 How fast 可以直接询问“最快多快能完成”：
How fast can four berry almond cakes bake
他特意把后面的 AND 重读出来，提醒别忘了烤完还得等冷却才能上桌：
AND cool
Forty minutes in the oven, thirty minutes to cool, ten minutes for warm honey glaze!
'烤箱里烤四十分钟，放凉三十分钟，再花十分钟刷温蜂蜜糖釉！' 泰莎在脑子里飞快排出一张精确到分钟的工序表：bake 用时后，再用不定式 to cool 交代这三十分钟的目的：
thirty minutes to cool
最后的糖霜淋面则用介词 for 来引出这一环节所需的十分钟：
ten minutes for warm honey glaze
That brings us to twenty-five past two — with thirty-five minutes to spare!
'这样算下来正好两点二十五分——还能富余出三十五分钟！' 欧文立刻跟着心算时间节点。bring us to 表示“算下来正好到某个时间点”，两点二十五分习惯说成 twenty-five past two：
That brings us to twenty-five past two
短语 to spare 放在时间后面非常实用，意思是“富余出……、还有……富余时间”：
with thirty-five minutes to spare
I will grease all four round tins with butter while you whisk the eggs, Tessa!
'你打鸡蛋的时候，我用黄油把四个圆形烤盘都抹一遍油，泰莎！' 确定来得及之后，大家马上分头下手。grease 表示“给烤盘抹油防粘”，tin 在烘焙里就是金属“烤模”：
I will grease all four round tins with butter
连词 while 衔接两人同步进行的动作，whisk 则专门指用打蛋器快速“搅打、打发”：
while you whisk the eggs
Hannah, rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries and pat them dry with linen!
'汉娜，把那四碗新鲜夏果冲洗一下，再用亚麻布轻轻拍干！' 泰莎也顺手把洗水果的活儿派给了还没离开的汉娜。动词 rinse 指用清水“冲洗、漂洗”：
rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries
后面的 pat dry 在菜谱里超级常见，意思是用干净布“轻轻拍干、蘸干水分”：
pat them dry with linen
Rinsing fast and gentle! Thank goodness we tested all three glazes on Sunday!
'洗得又快又轻柔！谢天谢地，咱们周日就把三种糖釉都试做过一遍了！' 汉娜一边快速冲洗浆果，一边庆幸大家提前试过配方。Thank goodness 就是地道感叹“谢天谢地、幸好”：
Thank goodness we tested all three glazes
表示在星期几时，前面固定用介词 on，并且星期几的首字母必须大写：
on Sunday
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish or Batch Two roof tiles at three today!
'真不敢想象今天三点端出第一批“擦铜水”或者第二批“屋顶瓦片”会是什么场面！' 欧文忍不住拿上次试烤翻车的成品开起了玩笑。记住动词 imagine 后面如果接动作，必须用动名词形式 serving：
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish
batch 指“一炉、一批次”，顺带调侃第二批硬得能当屋顶瓦片：
or Batch Two roof tiles
Less joking and faster whisking, Owen — fold the ground almonds in smoothly!
'少开玩笑快点搅打，欧文——把杏仁粉顺滑地翻拌进去！' 泰莎笑着督促他少贫嘴多干活。less 用来修饰不可数概念“少开点玩笑”，faster 是比较级“更快地”：
Less joking and faster whisking
到了把杏仁粉拌进蛋糊这一步，必须用烘焙专业词组 fold in，指轻柔“翻拌均匀”以免消泡：
fold the ground almonds in smoothly
Wait — hear Graham calling my name from the lobby? Something happened with the room keys!
'等一下——听见格雷厄姆在大厅喊我名字了吗？房间钥匙好像出事了！' 就在这时，汉娜听见外面传来呼喊声。感官动词 hear 后面用 calling，强调此刻正听见有人不断在喊：
hear Graham calling my name from the lobby
她立刻猜到是钥匙那边出了纰漏，动词 happen 搭配介词 with 表示“在……上出了事”：
Something happened with the room keys
Go save the front desk, Hannah; Owen and I own this kitchen until half past two!
'快去救场吧，汉娜；两点半之前这间厨房就交给我和欧文包圆了！' 泰莎大手一挥放汉娜先去灭火。美式口语里经常直接说 Go save，省略中间的 and 或 to：
Go save the front desk, Hannah
句尾的 own 原本是“拥有”，在这里带点豪气地说成“稳稳拿捏、包在我们身上”：
Owen and I own this kitchen
记住这种用法在鼓励队友时格外提气，相当于“这片场子有我和欧文兜底”。现在，让我们把厨房里这场紧张又默契的配合完整听一遍。
Emergency bulletin from the station desk: our mapmaker arrives at three sharp today!
Three in the afternoon?! Owen, turn both ovens up to baking heat this second!
Both switches on! How fast can four berry almond cakes bake AND cool, Tessa?
Forty minutes in the oven, thirty minutes to cool, ten minutes for warm honey glaze!
That brings us to twenty-five past two — with thirty-five minutes to spare!
I will grease all four round tins with butter while you whisk the eggs, Tessa!
Hannah, rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries and pat them dry with linen!
Rinsing fast and gentle! Thank goodness we tested all three glazes on Sunday!
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish or Batch Two roof tiles at three today!
Less joking and faster whisking, Owen — fold the ground almonds in smoothly!
Wait — hear Graham calling my name from the lobby? Something happened with the room keys!
Go save the front desk, Hannah; Owen and I own this kitchen until half past two!
在泰莎和欧文麻利的配合下，两台烤箱轰隆运转起来，而汉娜已经急忙赶回前台破解钥匙失踪之谜。我们下次见。
See you soon!
